program: Computational Biology and Biomedical Informatics (CBB) track (BBS)

requirements.quote: Applicants are expected 1) to have a strong foundation in the basic sciences, such as biology, chemistry and mathematics, and 2) to have training in computing/informatics, including significant computer programming experience.
to have a strong foundation in the basic sciences, such as biology, chemistry, physics, and mathematics
to have training in computing/informatics, including significant computer programming experience
In general, successful applicants will have completed undergraduate coursework in biology, chemistry at least through organic chemistry, physics, and calculus.
There are therefore no common courses required of all BBS applicants.
